software.description: Open-source authenticator with end-to-end encrypted backup and multi-device access.

evidence.claim: Ente documents optional offline use and end-to-end encrypted synchronization for Auth.
F-Droid lists Ente Auth 4.4.25 (1072) as requiring Android 7.0+, supporting arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a and x86_64, with a 61 MiB APK.

software.internetRequirement: Not required for offline code generation; required for encrypted synchronization and online account features
limitations: Provider-specific push approvals do not transfer as TOTP secrets
software.name: Ente Auth
software.networkActivity: Network is optional for local code generation; encrypted sync/backup requires network access

privacyDetails.collected: An Ente account is optional for offline-only Auth use; account and synchronization data are involved when encrypted sync is enabled.
privacyDetails.controls: Users can operate offline without an account, use encrypted synchronization, and create local encrypted backups/exports.
privacyDetails.deletion: Local and synchronized copies need to be handled according to the mode in use; exported backup files remain separate copies.
privacyDetails.encryption: Ente documents end-to-end encrypted synchronization for Auth data.
privacyDetails.practicalImplications: Offline mode reduces the service data boundary, while sync improves recovery and multi-device access. Backup passwords and exported files must be protected.
privacyDetails.purpose: Generate OTP codes locally and, when enabled, synchronize encrypted authenticator data across devices.
privacyDetails.recipients: Ente infrastructure receives encrypted synchronization data when sync is enabled.
privacyDetails.sharing: User-controlled export and encrypted sync are documented.

software.privacySummary: Ente publishes source and encryption documentation; an account is optional for local use and needed for encrypted synchronization.
software.requirementEvidence: F-Droid 4.4.25 metadata and Ente documentation, checked 2026-09-22
